title: Storefront Photos Load 60% Faster
summary: Storefront search results and vehicle pages show their photos much sooner. Search results now appear about 60% faster on a fast connection, and nearly 80% faster on a slow one.
body_markdown:
Summary


Storefront search results and vehicle pages show their photos much sooner. Search results now appear about 60% faster on a fast connection, and nearly 80% faster on a slow one.


Photos are most of what a shopper waits for on your storefront in the[Transaction Engine](https://www.ekho.com/transaction-engine) . As of this week they arrive much sooner, on every device and every connection, and you do not have to do anything to get it.


##


About 60% faster


On a fast connection, the first screen of search results now appears about 60% faster than it did. A shopper who lands on your inventory sees vehicles, with their photos, almost as soon as the page opens.


##


Nearly 80% faster on a slow connection


On a slower connection, like a phone with a weak signal in a parking lot, the gain is bigger: the same page appears nearly 80% faster. That is the shopper most likely to give up before the page finishes, and the one who gains the most.


##


The whole gallery keeps up


On the vehicle page, the gallery and the full-screen photos keep up as a shopper swipes through them. Search results further down the page fill in as the shopper scrolls toward them, so paging back and forth never leaves them looking at empty boxes.


##


As sharp as before


Every photo looks as sharp as it did, on a phone, a laptop or a large monitor. Your listing photos and the order they appear in stay exactly as you set them.


##


Where to find it


Open your storefront's search results or any vehicle page. There is nothing to turn on, and nothing to change about how you upload photos: every listing on your storefront loads faster.
